newsitem.title: USA: Cincinnati Purchasing Mgrs say Sept growth healthy.
newsitem.headline: Cincinnati Purchasing Mgrs say Sept growth healthy.

text.p: The Cincinnati chapter of the National Association of Purchasing Management's September report showed the broad-based recovery continuing and inflation "well under control," the group said on Monday.
"If this trend continues, we are showing healthy growth without concerns for an overheated economy," the group said.

Orders increased at a slightly lower rate than in August, the report said. A slight increase in commodity prices was balanced by level service prices and a slight decrease in equipment prices, it said. If the labor market remains tight, employers may need to recruit outside the area, it said.
